title: HAT-P-7 b period and consistency audit
question: Is the known transit independently recovered without obvious odd/even disagreement?
results: empirical permutation false-alarm probability ≤ 0.024 from 40 trials
box depth 5710 ppm; odd − even 140 ± 206 ppm across 557 measured events
validation: The period is searched over 1.5–4 days, the peak is compared with 40 within-quarter permutations, and depths are checked by parity and observing quarter.
provenance: quality flag = 0 and quarter-wise PDCSAP normalization
limitations: 40 permutations provide only a coarse false-alarm bound
PDCSAP processing can introduce quarter-dependent depth changes
box model omits limb darkening, dilution, and correlated noise
